report.title: Lazurio install · this machine's status
report.read_only: This first installer slice only inspects the machine and changes nothing.
report.footer: Run this command again at any time; it always derives the current state again.
reason.platform_unsupported: this platform is not supported yet
reason.bun_runtime_mismatch: Bun {current} does not match required version {required}
reason.bun_runtime_unavailable: the CLI is not running on a supported Bun runtime
reason.bun_runtime_not_on_path: the Bun runtime is running but the bun command is not available on PATH
reason.bun_path_identity_mismatch: the bun command on PATH is not the Bun runtime being verified
reason.bun_path_unusable: the bun command on PATH does not run with the exact required version
reason.node_runtime_current: Node.js {node_current} meets the minimum supported version {node_required}
reason.node_runtime_outdated: Node.js {node_current} is older than the minimum supported version {node_required}
reason.node_runtime_missing: a supported Node.js installation was not found
reason.node_runtime_not_on_path: Node.js is not available on the user PATH
reason.node_path_identity_mismatch: the node command on PATH is not a trusted Node.js installation
reason.node_runtime_unusable: the Node.js command on PATH could not report a supported version
reason.git_not_on_path: Git is installed but the git command is not available on PATH
reason.git_path_identity_mismatch: the git command on PATH is not the trusted Git installation
reason.git_unusable: Git was found but could not be executed
reason.github_cli_not_on_path: GitHub CLI is installed but the gh command is not available on PATH
reason.github_cli_path_identity_mismatch: the gh command on PATH is not the trusted GitHub CLI installation
reason.github_cli_unusable: GitHub CLI was found but could not be executed
reason.github_authenticated: GitHub CLI is signed in to github.com and uses the SSH protocol
reason.github_login_required: GitHub CLI needs a github.com sign-in
reason.github_ssh_protocol_required: GitHub CLI is signed in, but Git operations are not configured for SSH
reason.github_cli_unavailable: sign-in cannot be checked without GitHub CLI
reason.root_creation_required: the Lazurio Root needs to be generated
reason.source_root_ready: the Source Root is supported and verified
reason.source_root_unverified: the Source Root could not be verified as a clean canonical Lazurio checkout
reason.generated_root_ready: the generated Root and development source are present
reason.development_source_missing: the generated Root is missing development/Lazurio
reason.personalspace_root_not_supported: Personalspace cannot be used as the Lazurio Root
reason.root_unrecognized: the folder is not a recognized Lazurio Root
reason.root_path_unsafe: the selected path is not a safe directory
reason.root_probe_failed: the Lazurio Root could not be read safely
reason.probe_failed: the inspection ended with an unexpected error
action.bun_runtime_mismatch: The Agent must first ask the Principal for approval; then install exactly Bun {required} using the standard procedure for the detected installation method and run the check again.
action.bun_runtime_unavailable: Install exactly Bun {required} and run Lazurio CLI again.
action.bun_runtime_not_on_path: With the Principal's explicit approval, complete the standard Bun installation so exactly Bun {required} is on the user PATH; then verify `bun --version` in a new clean terminal and run the check again.
action.bun_path_identity_mismatch: Remove the earlier shadowing bun command from the user PATH, verify the exact `bun --version` in a new clean terminal, and run the check again.
action.bun_path_unusable: Repair the standard Bun installation so `bun --version` returns exactly {required} in a new clean terminal, and run the check again.
action.node_runtime_outdated: With the Principal's explicit approval, install Node.js {node_required} or newer from an official source, preserve the existing user PATH, and verify `node --version` in a new clean terminal.
action.node_runtime_missing: With the Principal's explicit approval, install Node.js {node_required} or newer from an official source, add only its actual installation directory to the user PATH, and verify `node --version` in a new clean terminal.
action.node_runtime_not_on_path: With the Principal's explicit approval, install Node.js {node_required} or newer from an official source or add its actual installation directory to the user PATH; then verify `node --version` in a new clean terminal.
action.node_path_identity_mismatch: Remove the earlier shadowing node command from the user PATH, verify `node --version` in a new clean terminal, and run the check again.
action.node_runtime_unusable: Repair the official Node.js installation so `node --version` reports {node_required} or newer in a new clean terminal.
action.git_missing: Install Git using your platform's standard procedure.
action.git_not_on_path: With the Principal's explicit approval, add Git's install directory to the user PATH, verify `git --version` in a new clean terminal, and run the check again.
action.git_path_identity_mismatch: Remove the earlier shadowing git command from the user PATH, verify `git --version` in a new clean terminal, and run the check again.
action.git_unusable: Repair Git and run the inspection again.
action.github_cli_missing: Install GitHub CLI (`gh`) using your platform's standard procedure.
action.github_cli_not_on_path: With the Principal's explicit approval, add GitHub CLI's install directory to the user PATH, verify `gh --version` in a new clean terminal, and run the check again.
action.github_cli_path_identity_mismatch: Remove the earlier shadowing gh command from the user PATH, verify `gh --version` in a new clean terminal, and run the check again.
action.github_cli_unusable: Repair GitHub CLI and run the inspection again.
action.github_login_required: With explicit approval to create or upload the SSH public key, run `gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol ssh --web` once; then verify `gh auth status`, the SSH protocol setting, and exact `git ls-remote` for the target Organization root.
action.github_ssh_protocol_required: Run `gh config set git_protocol ssh --host github.com`, verify or upload only the SSH public key with `gh ssh-key add`, and then run exact `git ls-remote` for the target Organization root.
action.root_creation_required: Wait for the next installer slice; this read-only slice intentionally does not change the folder.
action.source_root_unverified: Do not move the Root manually; give the report to an Agent who will verify the Git identity and checkout state.
action.development_source_missing: Add the canonical development source through the follow-up installer slice.
action.personalspace_root_not_supported: Choose a separate folder for the Lazurio Root.
action.root_unrecognized: Choose an empty folder or an existing Lazurio Root.
action.root_path_unsafe: Choose a real directory that is not a symlink or file.
action.root_probe_failed: Give the JSON report to an Agent and check permissions for the selected folder.
action.probe_failed: Give the JSON report to an Agent; the other independent checks still completed.
